glosses: caravan (convoy or procession of travellers, their cargo and vehicles, and any pack animals)
travel trailer (furnished vehicle towed behind another, and used as a dwelling when stationary)

examples.text: Il vit dans un terrain pour caravanes.
examples.en: He lives in a trailer park.
Tom lives in a camper van.

examples.text: Je pensais que tu avais vécu dans une caravane.
examples.en: I thought you used to live in a trailer.

examples.text: Une caravane de cinquante chameaux se dirigeait lentement à travers le désert.
examples.en: A caravan of fifty camels slowly made its way through the desert.
